name: 40222 · Louisville, KY
findings: ZIP 40222 (Louisville) has 172 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 68 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40222 (Louisville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
